column1: # Genes OwnHealth treats as sensitive (docs/design/genomics.md section 7), applied on top of the
# producer's sensitivity tag. GRCh38 spans (1-based, closed) of the HGNC gene, from the UCSC hg38
# search API, fetched 2026-11-07 (PLN 2026-11-11). acmg_sf_*: the cancer and cardiovascular genes of
# ACMG SF v3.3 (PMID 40568962): v3.2 (PMID 37347242) plus PLN. v3.3's two other additions, ABCD1 and
# CYP27A1, are metabolic genes, outside the cancer and cardiovascular groups this list holds. The
# ClinVar alert class "a change in an ACMG SF gene" is the acmg_sf_* rows of this file.
# Lookups pad each span by SPAN_PAD_BP so promoter-adjacent sites stay gated.
